svg.title: A maple in full autumn colour on a city promenade: a broad rounded crown of lit, base and shaded red foliage carried on a short trunk, THREE HEAVY BRANCHES splaying out of the trunk in the open band between the trunk head and the underside of the crown, standing in a kerbed tree pit of bare soil, with five fallen MAPLE leaves on the paving around it. The leaves are the species and they are drawn as the species: each is a five-lobed blade about 60 px across with deep sinuses between the lobes and a short stem, not a many-pointed star - the previous build drew them as sixteen-point rosettes that read as asterisks at play size, and a blind pass that could see it was autumn could not name the tree. The three branches are new for the same reason: they were in the file but every one of them was drawn inside a crown lobe and none was visible, so the trunk ran straight into the canopy. NO FLAG, no pole, no emblem, no banner, no lettering and no figure: the leaves here are leaves on a tree and on the ground, and nothing in this file is a device on a field. Drawn to the street trees and autumn colour in assets/refs/winnipeg/cmhr-from-the-forks-tower.jpg and cmhr-at-the-forks.jpg; see assets/refs/references.json, subject autumn-maple. POI hero, present at every visual tier.
